message: The query-builder config was not readable; documented parameter names use the package defaults (filter/sort/include/fields).
help: Publish the config (php artisan vendor:publish --tag=query-builder-config) so custom parameter names are reflected in the docs.

message: Filter "search" is handled by your own code and nothing types its value, so it is documented with no type at all.
help: Add #[QueryParameter(name: 'filter[search]', type: 'string')] to the action to give "search" a documented type — or, for a custom filter class, #[QueryParameter(type: 'string')] on the class, which types it on every route that registers it.
